'''Miguel Alderete''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 5th at [[2001 Denver World Qualifier]] on 30 June 2001, according to Brian Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2582">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-06-denver-world-qualifier-weekend-day-twod2582/ denver-world-qualifier-weekend-day-two], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 6 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-06-denver-world-qualifier-weekend-day-twod2582/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
